retirement_age.notes: From 1 January 2026 the target retirement age (riktålder) is 67. The earliest withdrawal of income and premium pension is 64, and the guarantee pension starts at 67. The age is indexed to life expectancy and set six years ahead. Employment protection (LAS) allows staying in work until 69.
